name: la-pluma-next
description: La Pluma Next - MAA CLI 的现代化 WebUI 与本地 Agent 控制台
author: dongwlin and contributors

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix client && npm run test --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run verify --prefix client && npm run verify --prefix server
